Molecules · inventory

Molecules are made of atoms: a list row is an icon holder, two lines of text and a chevron. This is a pass over all 68 screens and sheets. Each card shows what is on the screens today and proposes one molecule with its variants. Several look-alikes that are built separately today are brought together.

Each molecule is shown on its own: the screen, the card and everything around it are taken away. The red dashed line is its edge. The checkerboard shows where a molecule has no fill of its own, so any colour you see belongs to the molecule.

Atoms we missed · now fixed

Buttons made by hand

“Got it” (muted pill 40), “Earn more points” (white pill 42 with icon) and “See my rewards” (text, 40) are built outside the Button atom. Done: Button got size sm 40, fill muted and fill link; all three are Buttons now.

Text inputs made by hand

The inputs in the checkout forms (name, mobile, card) are drawn by the form, not by the Field atom: 2 border instead of 1.5, white instead of muted. Done: they are Field atoms now (muted fill, 1.5 border).

Status pill made by hand

“Ready now · held until 14 Oct” on the pickup card is a Badge with a check icon, built separately. Still open: becomes a Badge with an icon when we do the pickup card.

Organisms, for later

Bigger parts

These hold molecules and come after them: top bar, footer, sheet, cards with rows, action tiles (Get ready, Take a seat), facts card (Mark + meeting point), ticket, pickup card, invite card with QR, points card, reward card, locked reward, help card, the “You’re here” sheet.

Text styles (notes under footers, notices, centred lines) are typography from the foundations, not molecules. The push notification and the status bar imitate iOS, so they follow the system look, not Salmon tokens.
